joseph_smith.scribes: revelations dictated to scribes (Cowdery, Whitmer and others); ordinary: own hand, dictated letters and clerks' copies (the study's samples)

prophetic.rule: Revelation Book 1, every section the study cut out (1828-1833): the 1828-29 sample and the later sections (eval.js_later)

ordinary.rule: the study's candidate samples other than the revelations: letters, the 1832 history, journal, Letterbook 1 copies

john_wroe.scribes: communications 'taken from the mouth of John Wroe' by named scribes (Shand, Tillotson, Lees and others); the 1829 life is first person, scribe not stated

prophetic.rule: Private Communications vol. II (1846 printing of 1831-1845 communications), from the first dated communication; editors' footnotes not removed

ordinary.rule: Life and Journal (1829): the paragraphs where Wroe narrates his own life and travels in the first person (birth to illness; journeys of 1820; the corn; the court case of 1822); his vision accounts, the communications and the compilers' third-person paragraphs are left out (a duplicated page run, lines 132-171, skipped)

prophetic.note: 218 holds a scribe's line and the next dated heading

joanna_southcott.scribes: wrote her communications herself; copied by others for the press

prophetic.rule: The First and Second Book of the Sealed Prophecies (1803): verse runs only (her communications from the Spirit are mostly in verse); her prose letters in the same volume are left out

ordinary.rule: An Account of the Trials on Bills of Exchange (1807): her own prose account; verse runs dropped; short quoted letters from others not removed

prophetic.note: OCR of long s and st left errors the repair misses (mud, drongly)

anna_trapnel.scribes: the Cry was taken down by a 'relator' while she spoke in trance; the Report is her own narrative

prophetic.rule: The Cry of a Stone (1654): visions, prayers and songs uttered in trance, with the relator's framing (not removed)

ordinary.rule: Anna Trapnel's Report and Plea (1654): her narrative of the journey to Cornwall and her trial (quoted speech of others not removed)

prophetic.rule: The American Revolution written in Scriptural or Ancient Historical Style (1802 printing); verse runs (the poems printed with it) dropped after the hand check; chapter summaries and front matter not removed

ordinary.rule: The History of North and South America (1805); a compiled history that may draw on others' wording

prophetic.note: 0 is the title page and contents; first draw (before verse was dropped) also held a poem, 58

prophetic.rule: The History of Anti-Christ, written in Scripture style (1811)

ordinary.rule: The Life, Conversion, Preaching, Travels and Sufferings of Elias Smith (1816)

left_out_after_check.edward_burrough: post hoc: 0 of 11 ordinary-voice chunks attributed to him within the voice; his ordinary sample is two unlike documents, one a collective report

left_out.richard_brothers: ordinary voice only in unreadable OCR (letter to Stephens, 1795; letter to Miss Cott, 1798); A Revealed Knowledge is mostly his own exposition, not the Lord's words
left_out.james_strang: after 1830; four revelations located in the newspapers (Voree Herald lines 687, 6405, 8642; Zion's Reveille 1580), estimated well under min_words and OCR'd with columns interleaved (not counted, unverified); ordinary voice: Ancient and Modern Michilimackinac (1854)
left_out.elias_hicks: journal, letters and sermons: no text in the prophetic voice by the rule
left_out.job_scott: journal and treatises: no text in the prophetic voice by the rule

left_out.shaker_testimonies: many speakers and compilers, not one writer
left_out.handsome_lake: English translation, with the editor's (Parker's) own prose: not one writer
left_out.nat_turner: taken down and shaped by Thomas Gray; no ordinary voice
left_out.emanuel_swedenborg: both voices are a translator's English
left_out.jacob_ilive: Book of Jasher only; no ordinary prose held
